notes.note: Reviewed the merged SDK reference delta against query-core, analytics and devicePairingRequests. Analytics hooks apply 30-second polling and stale mount/focus refresh with caller overrides; rescan invalidates analytics and Insights prefixes. Paired-device reads key captured API base and authority, disable required-but-absent scope, forward scope and signal through getJson, and pause default polling on HTTP 401/403. The merged reference retains the separate Settings cache-refresh descriptions and explicit publication/provider/device limits. Integration guidance still routes to the stable SDK boundary; SDK instructions still require canonical reference maintenance and observable cancellation. Both append-only note histories are preserved. No further prose change is required for these merged claims.
